name: std/media
description: Audio/video/image codecs: MP3, DivX/MPEG video (+ IDCT, tables), WAV, GIF, AVI container, a codec registry and sound-device abstraction.
residual: Not in the headless SDK: the codecs render through Raster, and the four that do not are of no use without the ones that do.
Re-homed from misc: the media codecs (MP3Decoder, DivX*, MPEG*, WAVCodec, GIFCodec) that had zero fan-in in this tree but are library, not apps.

UNPLACED: Raster + WM* (WMGraphics/WMRectangles/WMWindowManager) — the players/viewers need the GUI/raster stack. Split codec cores (headless-usable) from the interactive players (MP3Player, WAVRecorder, MPEG viewer) which go to an apps area; the cores then need only std/gfx (Raster) once that package exists.
Codecs (the registry hub) pulls Archives -> std/archive; confirm during hub triage.
